intro: Covers the US session of Friday 23 October. SPI futures sources differ on level, so a range is shown; sector detail and European moves could not be verified.
footnotes: SPI 200 futures: TradingView shows the December contract at 8,774 (-0.49%) and Investing.com at 8,764 (-0.24%). Both agree on direction but differ on level, so a range and midpoint are used.
Gold: Trading Economics CFD reference US$3,993.96 (-0.77%); FNArena's weekly table shows US$4,027.38, a different snapshot time. The later CFD print is used.

Brent confirmed at US$116.72 by CNBC and Trading Economics. Yield, AUD/USD, gold and iron ore are Trading Economics CFD-based reference prices. The FNArena Monday report was not yet published at time of writing.

setup.summary: SPI 200 futures are down roughly 0.24-0.49% (level 8,764-8,774, December contract), pointing to an ASX 200 open about 32 points (0.37%) lower, near 8,763, at the midpoint. The ASX 200 closed Friday at 8,795.2, up 0.02%.

local_events: No major scheduled Australian data releases identified for today; September-quarter CPI is due Wednesday 28 October.
what_moved: Wall Street fell on Friday as Brent crude jumped to a six-month high near US$117 on expectations of renewed US strikes on Iran, and the US 10-year yield climbed back to 5.00%. The Dow fell 1.23%, the S&P 500 0.52% and the Nasdaq 0.21%, with the VIX up 2.2% to 19.45. Gold slipped. S&P 500 sector performance could not be verified.

news.headline: Brent settles at a six-month high near US$117
news.summary: Brent rose about 3.1% to US$116.72/bbl on Friday, its highest settlement since 29 April and a third straight weekly gain, as markets priced a likely resumption of US strikes on Iran. The Revolutionary Guard said seven vessels were hit or mined near the Strait of Hormuz.

news.headline: US 10-year yield returns to 5%
news.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 4 bp to 5.00% on Friday after dipping below that level on Thursday for the first time in a month.

news.headline: Dow leads Wall Street lower, but weekly picture is mixed
news.summary: The Dow fell 1.23% (about 653 points) on Friday. For the week the S&P 500 lost 0.47% and the Nasdaq 0.71%, while the Dow gained 0.41%; gold fell 3.49% and Brent gained 6.9%.

news.headline: Soft Australian earnings updates weigh on sentiment
news.summary: AGM updates and quarterlies have largely disappointed, with large guidance misses at Nick Scali and Zip. The ASX 200 slipped about 0.13% on the week and remains flat for the year, with Materials down about 6.6% and Energy down over 3% year to date.

news.headline: September-quarter CPI and a possible RBA hike in focus
news.summary: Australia's September-quarter CPI is due this week, and an RBA Deputy Governor's comments have flagged a possible rate hike at the 3 November meeting.

news.headline: Saudi Arabia reports intercepting Houthi missiles and drones
news.summary: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted missiles and drones launched by Iran-backed Houthis, adding to Gulf security concerns.

coming_up: Australia's September-quarter CPI is due Wednesday 28 October at 11:30am AEDT, ahead of the RBA decision on Tuesday 3 November, also the eve of the US midterm elections on 3 November.
